title: Whisper method guided meditation for sleep · Neville Goddard's inner conversation (50 min)
description:
A guided, whispered sleep meditation built on Neville Goddard's inner conversation: a short plain explanation, a few lines from the public-domain books, then a long, quiet stretch to fall asleep in the wish fulfilled.
The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.
50 min of soft whispering over dim, slow footage, no music.
